description: This file contains SCSS mixins for common styling patterns such as kill-background-image, kill-box-shadow, and clearfix. These mixins are reusable snippets that can be included in other SCSS files to standardize certain CSS behaviors across the project.

methods.name: kill-background-image
methods.description: Mixin to remove background images and filters from an element.

methods.name: kill-box-shadow
methods.description: Mixin to remove box-shadow from an element.

methods.name: clearfix
methods.description: Mixin to apply the micro-clearfix hack for clearing floats in CSS while addressing browser compatibility.
